text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Laurel-san!
What are you drinking?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
This? It's a green smoothie.
I made it myself.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Lately, I've ended up cooking too much food.
And since I ate it all myself, my weight...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
And so, I'm on a bit of a diet.
To manage my portion sizes, I'm drinking smoothies to keep myself feeling full.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "Whoaaa! Amazing! But don't you ever get tired of drinking the exact same thing all the time?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: At times like that, you change up the ingredients to switch the flavor. Coming up with flavor variations is fun, too♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's why I can keep it up every day. When it comes to dieting,
being able to stick with it without pushing yourself too hard is best, right?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Without pushing yourself too hard...! Ooh~~!
That sounds so mature and capable!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya wants to try that diet too!
Tell me, tell me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sure! I'll bring over
a smoothie recipe book next time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel stuck to a healthy, sensible diet.
Thanks to her efforts, she successfully got her weight back to normal!
